card.fires_on: Marked word or piece inside a longer term, such as the 'ag' in phagocytosis, the 'A' in CONTRAINDICATIONS, or 'Information' in an act name. It appears mostly in textbook or legal-style text.

modes.label: Inside biology words
modes.description: Middle piece of a cell biology term such as phagocytosis or intermediate filaments.

modes.label: Inside CONTRAINDICATIONS heading
modes.description: The 'A' in the capitalized section heading CONTRAINDICATIONS.

modes.label: Legal and policy phrases
modes.description: Word within a named law or legal phrase, such as an act title or breach of the standard.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long multi-part terms, mainly in biology, law and section headings, before the rest of the term follows.
